content: The reason for evil in the world is that people are not able to tell their stories.
author: Carl Jung
sourceWork: Modern Man in Search of a Soul (1933)
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Loneliness is the painful ache of feeling incomplete, while solitude is the rich discovery of your own inner presence. In a world full of constant stimulation and notifications, being alone with your thoughts can feel intimidating.

Carl Jung understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Yet silence is the only space where you can hear what your life is actually trying to say to you. When you make peace with quiet, you stop running to distractions to save you from yourself.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
